Lab reports specification triad for IFVG build

nodes.label: Fail-closed integration
nodes.rationale: Freqtrade adapter cannot create entries until all six components pass; unwired SMT stays false, keeping execution inert even in dry-run as a fail-closed milestone.

nodes.label: Completed candles only
nodes.rationale: All actionable computations use completed candles; confirmed pivots require right-side candles and become observable only after confirmation delay.

nodes.label: Dry-run submission code-lock
nodes.rationale: Dry-run submission remains code-locked until shadow review gate is added and passed; changing an environment variable alone cannot bypass it.

nodes.label: Hyperopt prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Before Hyperopt: pass unit tests, reconcile Pine behavior, run baseline backtest, then lookahead and recursive analysis.

nodes.label: execution_connected=false
nodes.rationale: Current evidence includes explicit execution_connected=false; execution tables remain inert until Freqtrade dry-run gate is reached.

nodes.label: Live execution separately reviewed
nodes.rationale: Wire validated setup eligibility into Freqtrade dry-run only; live execution remains a separately reviewed future decision.

nodes.label: No exchange keys in MVP
nodes.rationale: MVP must not receive exchange keys; Freqtrade starts stopped, force entry disabled, REST loopback-only.

nodes.label: Live-trading reviewed task gate
nodes.rationale: A future reviewed task is required before any live-trading path exists.

nodes.label: Missing Pine v6.3 limitation
nodes.rationale: Available Pine reference is v6.2 while brief asks for v6.3; v6.2 implemented where unambiguous and missing v6.3 is a known limitation.

nodes.label: Phase one vs research modules
nodes.rationale: Phase one implements six deterministic primitives; IFVG, V-recovery, signal tiers, Fib-sniper, session liquidity, and target boxes remain research modules and must not be silently blended into execution.

nodes.label: No institutional intent claims
nodes.rationale: No component asserts institutional intent; reports describe measured price behavior only.

nodes.label: Telegram never enables live mode
nodes.rationale: Custom reporting must allowlist users, audit mutations, require confirmation for dangerous actions, redact credentials, and never enable live mode.

nodes.label: Phase 5 dry-run lock
nodes.rationale: Phase 4 has no labelled ordered-episode dataset; specification prohibits Phase 5 dry-run connection; FvgProEliteStrategy emits no entries.

nodes.label: Strategy orchestration incomplete
nodes.rationale: Liquidity and episode services run from collector, but qualification, risk, recommendation refresh, outcome labelling and review sampling are not an automatic pipeline.

nodes.label: FreqAI shadow mode
nodes.rationale: First FreqAI experiment must generate, store, and compare predictions without creating or suppressing orders.

nodes.label: Deterministic strategy source of truth
nodes.rationale: Deterministic institutional-liquidity strategy remains source of truth for setup creation; FreqAI must not control entries, exits, sizing, or orders initially.

nodes.label: No reinforcement learning initially
nodes.rationale: Prefer simple supervised classifier or regressor for first experiment; do not introduce reinforcement learning in initial FreqAI phase.

nodes.label: Five layered trading intelligence functions
nodes.rationale: Partner images imply market reading, scenario generation, confirmation/execution, training/calibration, and learning from failure rather than a simple BUY/SELL indicator.

nodes.label: Liquidity Sweep Structure Shift FVG Retest
nodes.norm_label: liquidity sweep structure shift fvg retest

nodes.label: Structured market event language
nodes.rationale: Do not implement screenshots as visual indicators; implement structured event language for context, liquidity, structure, zones, confirmations, decisions, risk, and outcomes.

nodes.label: Social media as inspiration not proof
nodes.rationale: Screenshots are mostly social-media posts; treat as inspiration and vocabulary, not validated trading research; encode testable hypotheses.
nodes.norm_label: social media as inspiration not proof

nodes.label: Auction Market Theory
nodes.rationale: Treats every market as a continuous two-way auction seeking fair value; balance builds volume sideways while imbalance discovers new prices quickly.

nodes.label: Balance vs Imbalance
nodes.rationale: Balance implies reversion trades; imbalance implies continuation; first decision in the framework.

nodes.label: Footprint Chart
nodes.rationale: Finest resolution of order flow: bid vs ask volume at each price within a candle confirms who forced the move.

nodes.label: Absorption
nodes.rationale: Large resting orders absorb aggression without price breaking the level; mechanism that forms a valid Order Block.

nodes.label: Low Volume Node (LVN)
nodes.rationale: Thin gap where price moved on imbalance; price statistically likely to revisit and fill because never properly auctioned.

nodes.label: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
nodes.rationale: Functionally equivalent to an LVN: same imbalance phenomenon through a price-chart lens.

nodes.label: Order Block (OB)
nodes.rationale: Meaningful only when footprint shows real absorption plus next-candle delta shift; otherwise only a visual hypothesis.

nodes.label: Context → Location → Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Reading order: Auction Theory for context, Volume Profile for location, Footprint for confirmation; skipping layers makes later signals unreliable.

nodes.label: Freqtrade Execution Authority
nodes.rationale: Sole component permitted to submit, cancel, or modify exchange orders; direct CCXT is read-only.

nodes.label: Six-Component Confluence System
nodes.rationale: HTF bias, liquidity sweep, valid FVG retest, retest confirmation, SMT divergence, BOS/CHoCH each contribute one point; 6/6 is execution-eligible subject to risk.

nodes.label: Dry-Run Spot-Only MVP Safety
nodes.rationale: Live trading impossible by default; no accidental dry-run to live fallback; Telegram cannot enable live mode in MVP.

nodes.label: Host Bind-Mounted Data Directories
nodes.rationale: Containers are disposable; irreplaceable data must not live only in the container writable layer.

nodes.label: Strategy Version Configuration Hash Git SHA
nodes.rationale: Persist with every setup and trade so historical records remain interpretable after code or config changes.
nodes.norm_label: strategy version configuration hash git sha

nodes.label: Institutional Liquidity Hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Large participants interact with concentrated resting liquidity around obvious levels; software detects measurable behaviours, never claims institutional intent.

nodes.label: IFVG Confirmation Model
nodes.rationale: Inversion event after FVG invalidation following correct-side sweep and recovery; original FVG and IFVG stored as related distinct objects.

nodes.label: Parallel Signal Tiers A A+ A++
nodes.rationale: Do not assume A++ is more profitable; prove with platform data; one canonical setup ID prevents duplicate positions.
nodes.norm_label: parallel signal tiers a a+ a++

nodes.label: Fib Touch vs Retest Entry Distinction
nodes.rationale: 0.618/0.786 is where attention starts; trigger is confirming reaction candle close, never raw touch.

nodes.rationale: Sweep → V-shape recovery → IFVG → directional bias; all four mandatory in order or no signal.

nodes.label: Three Parallel Independently Configurable Streams
nodes.rationale: Parallel streams remove loose-vs-strict trade-off at signal generation; frequency/quality decision moves to sizing and stream selection; no disclosed backtest proves A++ wins more.

nodes.rationale: Most productive open-source path for signal-driven directional strategies; GPL-3.0 copyleft if distributing derivatives; OHLCV-only limitation.

nodes.rationale: No surveyed framework natively implements FVG/IFVG, sweep+V-recovery sequencing, Fib retest confirmation, box TP scoring, or A/A+/A++ parallel streams.

nodes.label: Canonical Liquidity Event Thesis
nodes.rationale: Edge is conditional probability after liquidity event, not knowledge of participant intent; crossing a level begins monitoring not entry.

nodes.label: GUI Research Workstation
nodes.rationale: Consumes canonical backend decisions; must not duplicate indicator, targeting, stop, or risk calculations in browser; no exchange credentials.

nodes.label: Stale Eligibility P0 Blocker
nodes.rationale: Eligible setup can remain eligible after evidence falls; must separate current eligibility from highest state reached.

nodes.label: Confluence-Based Trade Filtration System
nodes.rationale: Replaces rigid all-or-nothing parameter matching with a weighted scorecard so multi-asset universes can be screened for high-probability entries while suppressing low-quality setups.

nodes.label: Weighted Scorecard Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each candidate is scored across seven confluence categories with importance weights reflecting historical reliability as probability drivers, then tiered for position sizing.

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Filters (Stage 1)
nodes.rationale: Binary pass/fail conditions reject a setup before any scoring runs if any one gate fails.

nodes.label: Minimum Risk:Reward Gate
nodes.rationale: Projected R:R must be ≥ 1:2; below that the setup is rejected regardless of confluence score.

nodes.label: HTF Directional Bias Gate
nodes.rationale: HTF trend must resolve exclusively Bullish or Bearish; Ranging HTF disqualifies the setup with no scoring applied.

nodes.label: Session / Kill-Zone Timing Gate
nodes.rationale: Entry must fall inside the asset's active liquidity window; setups outside kill zones are down-weighted or rejected.

nodes.label: Market Structure Shift + Displacement
nodes.rationale: Sharp displacement leaving an unmitigated FVG or inverse FVG confirms institutional intent rather than a slow drift.

nodes.label: Premium/Discount Positioning
nodes.rationale: Entry should be in discount (longs) or premium (shorts) of the HTF dealing range, not chasing an extended move.

nodes.label: Asset-Class Specific Layer
nodes.rationale: Category 7 filters are not interchangeable; apply only the layer matching the asset being screened.

nodes.label: Trade Rating System
nodes.rationale: Final tier combines scorecard points with a minimum R:R floor; a high score with insufficient R:R is capped at the tier below.

nodes.label: Scoring Engine
nodes.rationale: Runs the 100-point scorecard only after R:R and directional-bias gatekeepers pass.

nodes.label: VIX Filter
nodes.rationale: Only trade ES/NQ/YM setups when VIX > 16; low-VIX sessions materially reduce win rate on breakout-style entries.

nodes.label: News Blackout
nodes.rationale: Stop generating FX entries 15 minutes before/after CPI, NFP, and FOMC releases.

nodes.label: TradeMonke Desktop (Ubuntu)
nodes.rationale: Desktop shell hides day-to-day Compose commands while Docker remains the runtime; package is dry-run / spot research only and does not unlock live trading.

nodes.label: trademonke-update.sh
nodes.rationale: Fast-forward-only merge, rebuild, migrate, restart; .env and runtime/ are never overwritten by git.

nodes.label: Dry-Run / Spot Research Only Safety
nodes.rationale: Desktop package deliberately does not unlock live trading; Telegram and Freqtrade are not started by the desktop icon.

nodes.label: TradeMonke Lab Research GUI
nodes.rationale: Dry-run research workstation with a primary reading path of watchlist, three questions, chart overlays, optional soft-label patterns, then collapsed advanced tools.

nodes.label: Pattern Kit (Soft-Labels)
nodes.rationale: Patterns carry soft_label=true and authority=none; toggles only change what is drawn, and Location prefers HTF context when a pattern hint disagrees.

nodes.label: Shadow Execution
nodes.rationale: Stays under Advanced and remains fail-closed when dry-run submission is locked; live trading is prohibited.

nodes.label: Dual-Path Market Data Architecture
nodes.rationale: REST OHLC persists closed candles for authoritative calculations while public WebSocket v2 relays BBO and forming OHLC for GUI presentation only, keeping live feeds out of detection through execution.

nodes.label: live-price.v1
nodes.rationale: Decimal midpoint of best bid/ask; drives watchlist and toolbar; authoritative=false, not stored, must never enter detection/lifecycle/scoring/risk/recommendation/execution.

nodes.label: live-candle.v1
nodes.rationale: Drives only the forming chart bar; browser rejects it unless interval is newer than latest persisted closed bar; authoritative=false.

nodes.label: Chart Overlay Toggles
nodes.rationale: Control chart geometry only; hiding or showing a layer never changes stored evidence, setup score, recommendation validity, risk, or execution state.

nodes.label: Soft-Label Patterns
nodes.rationale: Optional location tags from closed-candle confirmed pivots; never create entries, scores, risk approvals, or order intents.

nodes.label: CCXT Public Read-Only Collector
nodes.rationale: Instantiates CCXT without credentials and exposes no order methods; funding and OI are supplemental research inputs, never execution inputs.

nodes.label: Watchlist Admission
nodes.rationale: Adjacent assets must earn admission from measured evidence (continuity, spread, volume persistence, correlation usefulness, FVG/setup samples) rather than hard-coded popularity.

nodes.label: Persistent Backfill Job
nodes.rationale: Confirming a probe creates jobs for every configured timeframe; interrupted running jobs return to pending and resume idempotently.

nodes.label: Funding and Open Interest
nodes.rationale: Contract-only supplemental research metrics; may be absent even when spot OHLCV is available; never execution inputs.
